sloka: ऐरावतान् ऐन्द्र शिरान् नागान् वै प्रिय दर्शनान् ।खरान् शीघ्रान् सुसम्युक्तान् मातुलो अस्मै धनम् ददौ ॥२-७०-२२॥
transliteration: airāvatān aindra śirān nāgān vai priya darśanān ।kharān śīghrān susamyuktān mātulo asmai dhanam dadau ॥2-70-22॥

translations.english: His maternal uncle gave him the wealth of goodlooking elephants born in Iravata and Indrasira mountains and swiftmoving and welltrained asses which can be yoked easily. He gave riches too.
